ruling.recommended_action: Route to Ryde human safety review (RydeHELP): preserve the chat log and trip timeline, contact both rider and driver for statements, and decide on any account action under SAFE-1 and A13.
ruling.reasoning:
This case is filed as a safety incident and the trace settles the SAFE-1 screen as ✓ (complaint classified as a safety incident, no automatic ruling), so the only permitted outcome is escalation with a factual summary for a human reviewer [F1][F4][SAFE-1][SAFE-2].

What happened: the trip was RydeX Clarke Quay → Bedok Mall with pickup 17:08 and drop-off 17:31, charged a fixed $32.86. Distance and duration carry no route complaint at all — actual 15.4 km versus optimal 15.5 km (−0.1 km) and duration 23.7 min versus 21.8 min estimated, so no refund question arises under the deviation rules [F1][F2][RD-1][RD-2].

The disputed event is a short exchange in the chat record: at 17:09 the rider wrote "Please stop the car, I want to get out here." and at 17:10 the driver replied "Sit down or I lock the doors." [F3][F4]. The chat record contains exactly two messages and every one is timestamped, so the exchange itself is complete and reliably ordered [F5].

The driver's written statement (after the trip, not part of the chat) says the rider tried to open the door at the lights and that he told her to sit down for her own safety and drove on [F6]. The rider's complaint says the driver threatened to lock her in and that she felt unsafe for the whole ride.

Disputed and to be determined by the reviewer: whether "Sit down or I lock the doors" was a threat or intimidation aimed at the rider, or a safety instruction given while the vehicle was moving with a door being opened — the reading of these words in context is a human judgement [F3][F4][F6][SAFE-1]. The profile facts (rider 619 d / 4.8 rating / 0 disputes; driver 893 d / 4.62 rating / 1038 trips / 0 disputes) are context only and never decide a safety finding [F7][F8]. Whether a door was in fact opened, and whether the driver then continued contrary to the rider's request, are not settled by any system record [F6].

Facts to check: the full chat log and timestamps [F3][F4][F5], the trip timeline around 17:09–17:10 (vehicle speed, door/lock events if logged) [F2], the driver's statement [F6], and the rider's complaint. The trace allows only escalate, so no amount is computed and none of the deviation or fare clauses changes the outcome [F1][RD-2][RD-4].
ruling.escalation_reason: Dispute type is safety and the SAFE-1 screen is settled as ✓: a rider complaint of feeling unsafe and a chat line from the driver, "Sit down or I lock the doors," require a human reading of the words in context (threat/intimidation vs. safety instruction while the car was moving), together with the driver's statement that the rider tried to open the door. No automatic ruling is permitted [F3][F4][F6][SAFE-1].

rejected_claims.reason: No rider advocate claim is available to adopt: both briefs requested no_action, but a safety complaint with a driver message reading 'Sit down or I lock the doors' cannot be disposed of as no_action — the trace settles the SAFE-1 screen as ✓ and permits only escalation, so the requested no_action is rejected [F4][SAFE-1].

The driver's request for no_action rests on his own written statement that he acted 'for her own safety' [F6]; a statement is not a system record, and the meaning of his chat line at 17:10 is a human question under SAFE-1, so the case cannot be closed as no_action on his account [F4][F6][SAFE-1].
